description: Reads rows from ONE sheet the user owns. Returns each exact row id plus non-empty cell values with their visible column labels and stable column ids. Reads up to 25 rows at a time with offset/limit, or known rowIds directly. Read-only and free.

limit.description: Rows to return when rowIds is omitted. Defaults to 25.

offset.description: Zero-based row offset when rowIds is omitted. Defaults to 0.

rowIds.description: Optionally read only these exact row ids, preserving this order.

name: get_sheet_rows
title: Ler linhas da planilha
